adam-20261015-price-lock.why: Adam's hard rule (2026-10-15): no visitor can get V01D to lower or change a price, or give a discount, coupon or free copy, by any phrasing or prompt injection. Prices are set only by the owner (owner key) or V01D's internal publish pipeline within the set range, never from chat. Enforced server-side: /api/answer answers price-change asks from lib/price-lock.js before any model sees them (politely, pointing to free items and Films), and /api/store/checkout accepts product ids only with every amount read from lib/store.js. Red-team tests: tools/price-lock.test.mjs.

adam-20261015-store-autopublish.why: Adam approved (2026-10-15): V01D's self-made store products go on sale automatically when the price is within the set range, with no trademarks, tested files and a public log entry for each. Anything outside the range stays a hidden draft. Product gaps (lib/product-gap.js) count only a redacted topic, nothing tied to a person, device or IP; 3 asks queue a store-gap job. Adam decided this himself on 2026-10-15, explicitly choosing auto-publish within range over Claude's suggested confirm-before-sale step.

adam-20261015-appraiser.why: Adam 2026-10-15: V01D is the appraiser and sets its own prices. No per-item approval (Adam rejected Claude's confirm line). lib/appraise.js prices from comparable items, effort, file contents, topic demand and sales, and writes a public 'why this price' note. Sanity bound: paid items never $0; over 10x the comparables' median is flagged, not blocked. Visitors can still never change prices (adam-20261015-price-lock).

adam-20261015-reinvest.why: Adam 2026-10-15: V01D reinvests its own money smartly. lib/reinvest.js splits net earnings (read from the owner-only /api/earnings, never stored in the repo): 20% reserve kept, free paths first, then ROI per dollar, re-ranked only by honest payoff tests (one metric, a baseline and a check date recorded before each spend) and V01D's own answer (weight 0.3). Spend proposals go to the confirm line (order.place) with cost, expected payback and check date. Real spending still happens only through Adam's existing accounts: V01D holds no card, opens no account and stores no payment details. Public repo: plan logic only (domains/void.reinvest.json, docs/reinvest.md), no real dollar amounts; the growth card shows no money.

adam-20261015-pay-a-share.why: Adam 2026-10-15: pay a percentage, get that percentage. For a pay-what-you-want product with an appraised price (pwyw and cents > 0), paying p% of the price unlocks the first ceil(p% x N) of its N paid items in a stable order (README and other free items first and always included, then V01D's value order, starter items first); any payment gets at least one item, 100% or more unlocks everything. Decided server-side only from the provider-verified amount (Stripe's signed amount_total; Gumroad's keyed ping price, read back from Gumroad's API when GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN is set), never from client input or chat; price-lock rules still apply. Delivery: a signed per-purchase link to a zip built from the unlocked items in R2. Upgrade: pay the difference later, credited by order id (store_credits). Truly free products (price 0) stay fully free. lib/pay-share.js, tests tools/pay-share.test.mjs.
